name: Google Workspace Identity Provider
author: McSparrow <hi@mcsparrow.dev>
description: Google Workspace identity provider (also works for personal @gmail.com accounts). OIDC authorization-code flow against accounts.google.com plus the Google Admin SDK Directory API for group fetching when a domain is configured. Required fields: client_id, client_secret, default_role_id; optional hosted_domain (lock to a Workspace), scopes, group_filter. Tile shows up in Settings > Security > Identity Providers as 'Google'.
